lookups.title: Searches
lookups.description: Every parts search of the company, from the web or WhatsApp, in one queue.

list.title: Search queue
list.description: Searches from the counter and from WhatsApp, newest first.
list.stale: The searches shown may be out of date.

empty.title: No searches yet
empty.description: When your team or a WhatsApp contact searches a part, its vehicle, parts and result appear here.
empty.filtered-description: Clear the filter to see every search of the company.

new.title: Find the part.
new.description: Enter the registration plate and the part you need. The result stays in the company search queue.
new.plate-hint: Spaces, dots and dashes are fine.
new.query-hint: Be specific: part name and position, if known.

tips.title: Search tips
tips.body: Check the registration plate, and include the position of the part, such as front or rear.

errors.plate: Check the plate: 4 to 8 letters and digits.
errors.query-required: Enter the part you need, such as front brake pads.
errors.query: Describe the part in 2 to 200 characters.

lookups.fitment: Results are identification guidance. Always confirm vehicle fitment and current price before purchase.

detail.title: Search result
detail.description: The vehicle, the status and the parts found, updated while the search runs.
detail.stale: This search may be out of date.

running.title: Searching the catalog
running.description: The result shows here as soon as it is ready, no need to reload. You can leave this page, the search keeps going.

unavailable.title: Details unavailable
unavailable.description: The search is done, but its parts are no longer available. Search again to see them.

vehicle-not-found.title: Vehicle not found
vehicle-not-found.description: The catalog does not know this registration plate. Check it and search again.

not-matched.title: No category matched
not-matched.description: The vehicle was identified, but no part category matched the request. Try a more specific part name or its position.

failed.title: The search failed
failed.description: The catalog could not complete the search. Try again in a moment.

results.no-parts: No parts listed for this unit.
